mapper.insert: insert into QA_FA_STAGE_RESULT ( ID, RECORD_ID, STAGE_CODE, STAGE_NAME, SORT_NO, STATUS, FINAL_REQUIRED, RELEASE_ON_PASS, JUDGE_USER_ID, JUDGE_USER_NAME, JUDGE_TIME, COMMENT_TEXT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) values ( #{id}, #{recordId}, #{stageCode}, #{stageName}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{finalRequired}, #{releaseOnPass}, #{judgeUserId}, #{judgeUserName}, #{judgeTime}, #{commentText}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: select S.ID, S.RECORD_ID, S.STAGE_CODE, S.STAGE_NAME, S.SORT_NO, S.STATUS, S.FINAL_REQUIRED, S.RELEASE_ON_PASS, S.JUDGE_USER_ID, NVL(U.FULLNAME, S.JUDGE_USER_NAME) as JUDGE_USER_NAME, S.JUDGE_TIME, S.COMMENT_TEXT, S.CREATE_TIME, S.UPDATE_TIME from QA_FA_STAGE_RESULT S left join USERPROFILE U on U.USERNAME = S.JUDGE_USER_ID where S.RECORD_ID = #{recordId} order by S.SORT_NO, S.STAGE_CODE
